display_title: Cicadas Do Not Cry When It Rains
description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/3135), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=2933615), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/50428211), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/678008335), [Bufftoon](https://bufftoon.plaync.com/series/1000865)
"Should I have died instead?"

In elementary school, Do-chan lost his friend in a traffic accident.
After the accident, Do-chan begins to live as his dead friend...

A coming-of-age drama about five friends who live different lives due to the accident that day.
